name: JV_DISTRIBUTIONS
description: This table contains distribution records generated for each stakeholder from the processing of joint venture transactions.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a distribution record generated from the processing of a joint venture transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture transaction that the distribution was created from.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the journal entry default effective date for journal entries or the transaction date for subledger entries.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_PERCENTAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the ownership percentage definition.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture stakeholder that is associated with the distribution of the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTED_DEBIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The distribution debit amount for the stakeholder in the accounting currency.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTED_CREDIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The distribution credit amount for the stakeholder in the accounting currency.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_OF_INTEREST
columns.description: The percent of ownership a stakeholder has in a joint venture transaction.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code to identify the state of the distribution of the joint venture transaction. It is based on the ORA_JV_DISTRIBUTION_STATUS lookup codes like Available to Process, Process Complete, and so forth.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of transaction the distribution represents, such as Expense, Revenue, and so forth.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the source joint venture transaction.

columns.name: ROUND_AMOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: A flag to identify if rounding was applied to the distribution amount.

columns.name: TARGET_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the transaction ID of the AR invoice, AP invoice or journal entry created for the joint venture distribution.

columns.name: CHILD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifies the request ID of the child job that was used to process the distribution record.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the joint venture assigned to the distribution.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the joint venture stakeholder is only participating in the distribution and not being invoiced.

columns.name: ERROR_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Indicates the error group number for a set of distribution IDs encountered while creating invoices.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number of the invoice transaction generated for the distribution.

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: The date of the invoice transaction generated for the distribution.

columns.name: ADVANCE_PAYMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the advance payment this distribution record was assigned and drawn from.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number used when a distribution record is split between multiple advance payments, or an advance payment and an AR invoice.

columns.name: ORIG_DISTRIBUTED_AMOUNT_DEBIT
columns.description: The original debit amount of the joint venture distribution in the accounting currency. This is the amount prior to being split by partner contributions.

columns.name: ORIG_DISTRIBUTED_AMOUNT_CREDIT
columns.description: The original credit amount of the joint venture distribution in the accounting currency. This is the amount prior to being split by partner contributions.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The code that indicates the type of distribution line. It is based on ORA_JV_DISTRIBUTION_LINE_CODE lookup codes such as ORA_JV_CANCEL, ORA_JV_REVERSE, and so forth.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the original distribution line. This is populated in a reversed distribution line, a distribution line created to reassign a stakeholder, and a distribution line created due to a partner contribution split.

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: The code that indicates the reason for canceling the distribution line. It is based on ORA_JV_CHANGE_REASON_CODE lookup codes such as ORA_JV_INCORRECT_OPD_PERCENT, ORA_JV_INCORRECT_INV_INFO, and so forth.

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_ADDITIONAL_TEXT
columns.description: Additional information describing the reason for canceling the distribution line.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the partner contribution this distribution record was assigned and drawn from.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the distribution amount was reversed and needs to be added back into the partner contribution open amount.

columns.name: PROJECT_COSTING_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the export status of the joint venture offset accounting entries to the Project Costing system.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_NUM
columns.description: Unique identifier for the GL distribution associated with the joint venture distribution invoice or journal entry. This value is used to retrieve the general ledger account identifier.

columns.name: TARGET_TRANSACTION_HEADER_CCID
columns.description: Account combination identifier for the offset account to the partner account used when creating receivables invoices, payables invoices, and internal transfers.

columns.name: PARTNER_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Account combination identifier for the partner account used when creating receivables invoices, payables invoices, and internal transfers.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_START_DATE
columns.description: Effective start date of the ownership definition that was used to distribute a joint venture transaction.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_END_DATE
columns.description: Effective end date of the ownership definition that was used to distribute a joint venture transaction.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTED_ENTERED_CREDIT
columns.description: The distributed credit amount for the stakeholder in the entered currency.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTED_ENTERED_DEBIT
columns.description: The distributed debit amount for the stakeholder in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code entered on the original transaction.

columns.name: ORIG_DISTRIBUTED_ENTERED_DR
columns.description: The original debit amount of the joint venture distribution in the entered currency. This is the amount prior to being split by partner contributions.

columns.name: ORIG_DISTRIBUTED_ENTERED_CR
columns.description: The original credit amount of the joint venture distribution in the entered currency. This is the amount prior to being split by partner contributions.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTNER_CONTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the partner contribution created from a partner contribution request. The system populates this ID when the open distribution amount is selected to calculate the partner contribution for a stakeholder.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the stakeholder that was originally associated with the distribution line.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_RPTG_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status of the accounting for stakeholder reporting books.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_RPTG_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ledger used for stakeholder reporting books.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_RPTG_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the transaction ID of the stakeholder reporting journal created for the distribution.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
